source.check: divisions, names and votes read from the Irish News's North Antrim results (6 June 1936, p. 9)

note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in North Antrim took place on Thursday 4 June 1936 and the results were declared on Friday 5 June. Two divisions were contested; the rest were filled at the nominations. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Antrim that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). M'Kinney; Stuart, J.P., the defeated member. Majority 108.
